title: Customer Loyalty
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight embarks on a quest to find the Holy Grail based on a mysterious letter, only to discover a fake grail and playing cards. Meanwhile, Nellie and Erin create a fake social media profile to boost Dunder Mifflin's online presence. Jim is stuck in Philadelphia and misses his daughter Cece's ballet recital, which Pam attempts to record but fails. Dwight confronts Jim about poaching Darryl to his new company, Athlead, raising concerns about employee loyalty. The office navigates tensions around loyalty, relationships, and work stress, culminating in emotional moments and unresolved conflicts.
